English: Cleared Field
A patch of earth cleared of brush and stones, providing a space for basic foot drills and simple martial gatherings.
Training Patch
A more defined area marked by wooden posts and basic fencing, used for regular weapons practice and drills.
Drill Ground
A leveled field with marked lanes and makeshift shelters, suitable for organized drilling and rudimentary formation practice.
Archery Range
A dedicated space with straw targets, covered shooting stands, and a small store of bows for regular archery practice.
Tilting Yard
A fenced and sanded yard with tilting barriers and pavilions, allowing for cavalry drills, jousts, and advanced knightly training.
Obstacle Course
A complex of wooden barricades, ditches, walls, and rope climbs, designed to test the endurance and agility of all castle levies.
Combat Pit
A deepened pit surrounded by wooden palisades, used for live combat drills and mock battles under the watchful eyes of seasoned instructors.
Siege Practice Yard
A fortified training ground with mock walls, siege towers, and engines for drilling troops in the arts of siegecraft and defense.
Warriors Arena
A grand, stone-walled arena for martial tournaments, public drills, and the training of elite retainers, inspiring awe in friend and foe alike.
Champions Grounds
A vast, masterfully engineered training complex with permanent barracks, stables, and command towers, where the mightiest of knights and warriors hone their skills.
